response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates solid experience with distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure, they fail critical minimum requirements. Most significantly, they have only ~6 months to 1 year of professional C++ experience versus the required 8 years—a fundamental gap for this role. Additionally, there is no evidence of formal technical leadership or direct mentoring of engineers, and limited cloud architecture specialization. The career trajectory shows breadth across web, mobile, and embedded technologies rather than deep focus on cloud compute platforms.
strengths: Proven expertise with large-scale distributed systems and microservices infrastructure handling millions of HTTP requests per second at Dunnhumby
Successfully launched and scaled multiple products to production including WatchUp iOS/Apple TV apps ranking top 10 in US market
Strong software craftsmanship foundation with demonstrated ability to establish best practices, mentor through workshops/courses, and promote TDD methodology
concerns: Critically lacks C++ experience with only ~6 months to 1 year of professional exposure versus 8-year minimum requirement
No formal technical leadership role or documented experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers despite staff-level titles
Career shows broad technical generalism across multiple domains rather than deep specialization in cloud compute architecture and platforms

key_factors.factor: Absence of Formal Technical Leadership Role
